svg.aria-label: FinSight and Kestrel full architecture: browser, FinSight server, Kestrel agent, model providers, tools, MCP, databases and external data services
svg.text: FinSight + ↗ Kestrel — full component architecture · everything below the dashed line runs on your Mac
LOCAL STORAGE · ~/FinSightData (outside the repo) · macOS Keychain
64 KB body (22 MB for uploads) · 503 if offline
spawn on start · restart w/ backoff (5/10 min)
Tool registry · 35 read-only tools · zod schemas → JSON Schema
no tool can trade, move money, message anyone or edit FinSight data
every model/tool/API call · turnId via ALS
SKILL.md · hot reload · install from GitHub
read by the Records tools · recordsDir
never logged, never in a prompt
market data over HTTPS · FinSight is the single owner
① panel POSTs /api/agent/threads/:id/messages → ② FinSight checks PIN + origin, adds secret → ③ Kestrel API checks Host/secret, engine claims the thread
④ engine sends system prompt + skills index + context pack + history to the chosen model → ⑤ model asks for tools → ⑥ tools call FinSight (GET token), sandbox, SEC, web
⑦ results go back to the model (loop ≤ 12 steps) → ⑧ answer streams to the panel over SSE → ⑨ messages, events, trace, cost and log lines are written; trace button shows them
